ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_softmax_advantage_weighted_repaired
ir.intuition: Adjusted weighting to multiply exp of scaled margin by weight only, removed abs on advantage_gap and used advantage_gap directly to maintain correct gradient sign and sensitivity to objective changes. Normalized softmax weights using stable sum clamp to ensure numerical stability and sensitivity. This fix enhances responsiveness of loss to advantage_gap perturbations, resolving insensitivity.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = lpw - lpl
scaled_margin = alpha * margin
exp_margin = exp(scaled_margin)
weighted_exp = exp_margin * advantage_gap * weight
norm_factor = clamp(sum(weighted_exp), 1e-6, 1e6)
softmax_weights = weighted_exp / norm_factor
loss = -sum(softmax_weights * logsigmoid(scaled_margin))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    exp_margin = ops.exp(scaled_margin)
    weighted_exp = ops.mul(ops.mul(exp_margin, advantage_gap), weight)
    norm_factor = ops.clamp(ops.sum(weighted_exp), 1e-6, 1e6)
    softmax_weights = ops.div(weighted_exp, norm_factor)
    log_sig = ops.logsigmoid(scaled_margin)
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(softmax_weights, ops.neg(log_sig))
    loss = ops.sum(loss_per_pair)
    return loss
